summary.label: A: Current compiler.md
summary.description: Front-loads outcome, scope, forbidden actions, stop triggers, separates observed/reported/unverified evidence, and adapts format by target model tier.

summary.label: B: Outcome/Scope/Constraints/Done
summary.description: Compact 4-block contract (Outcome, Scope, Constraints, Done) without separate evidence-tier headers.

summary.label: C: Flat checklist
summary.description: Minimal ordered checklist (Goal, Do not, numbered steps) optimized for low token footprint on weak/fast models.

summary.label: D: Evidence-first
summary.description: Leads with full Observed, Reported, and Unverified sections before Outcome, Scope, Forbidden, Subtasks, and Done across all tracks.

summary.label: E: Risk-adjusted
summary.description: Scales section depth by track (fast, guided, deep) while preserving forbidden actions, grounding labels, and subtask boundaries.
